description: Linear / integer program solver — Solve a linear program offline (two-phase simplex): objective= linear expression like 3x+5y, constraints= separated by ; using <=, >= or = (variables allowed on both sides), sense=max|min (default max). Variables are >= 0 unless listed in free=. integer=true (or integer=x,y) runs branch-and-bound for integer/binary (add x<=1) problems. Returns OPTIMAL/INFEASIBLE/UNBOUNDED, objective value, variable values, per-constraint slack, binding constraints and shadow prices. Up to 60 variables and 150 constraints. Use for production mix, diet/blending, budget allocation, knapsack, staffing. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_linear_program
